notes.title: Boob Physics & Love for Linux
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow Titty Lovers.[/b]

Since you obviously [i]love[/i] titties, we have fantastic news for you.
The update you all were longing for is finally here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32617962/1a1d36e9ca2df9667c6f22387fffdc2223d22b8f.gif[/img]

We are proudly presenting our brand new sophisticated [b]boob physics[/b].
The better you play, the harder they bounce. ;)

But it gets even better: We are no longer leaving Linux users in the rain and without the warmth of a bosom. With this latest update, Titty Crush now features a Linux version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32617962/b0f492a95c57bffc3fb43d26a623e302b13aa0d5.png[/img]

We hope you all enjoy the gravity-defying results of your fruit matching.

Milk Shake

notes.title: Valentine's Patch: Your tongue is so skilled Senpai!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32617962/60bb67424a4294867648f64b3e49d598eec6a2e1.jpg[/img]

Happy Valentine’s Day fellow titty lovers.

We got you a great present for this special occasion.

Valentine's day is on 14.02 so you’ll save 28% (2x14) on Titty Crush.
Because today is such a special day, we also added a Japanese and a German translation. 
(The game uses automatically your system language).

Spread the love with your (native) tongue

Milk Shake

notes.title: Christmas Patch: Let's have a white Christmas Senpai!
notes.content:
Ho ho ho fellow Titty lovers.

Christmas is coming, and we hope so are you. ;)

You’ve been pretty naughty this year, but we’ve got you a present.
A limited time Christmas special. Don’t miss it.

Oh and by the way, this is most likely the "patch" you have been waiting for! There’s more content and much more to see. ;) 

Happy Holidays

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32617962/bb9682ff8782233bc04d2370861efe64fdedac00.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First Patch: You are (too) fast Senpai!
notes.content:
Goooooood Moooorning, fellow Titty Lovers.

First let me thank you all for your support and for your feedback!

We tried to incorporate as much feedback as possible into our patch,
but we were not able to implement it all (yet).

Todays features are:

[list]
[*] [b] New Speedrun mode! [/b] (still playable with one hand!)

[*]  [b]Achievements are working![/b] (and there is also a new one ;) )

[*]  [b]More text![/b] (since you are all here for the story, right ;) )

[*]  [b]Time limit from the story is removed!![/b] (So you can relax ;))

[*]  [b]Bugs crushed!![/b] (With our titties!!)

[*]  [b]Added a "coming" soon![/b] (Since people were confused :-( )

[/list]

There is no new visual content yet, but we wanted to do a patch anyway to implement as much of your feedback as possible!

As always feel free to post your feedback!
